notes.title: New Huge Mutant Alley Update Ahead
notes.notes:
Hey there,
the year is almost over and Mutant Alley will receive a new huge update in the beginning of december, it will be the last update for this year but for sure not the last ever, the new features will allow the game to be extended in even new ways:)

Besides tons of bug fixes and improvements the game will finally receive a couple mode so that you can play with bot characters at the same time AND it will also feature couple actions!

Please also check out the latest MA reviews by Chapomon and TwosomesAfterDark, both of them received the latest beta version and will give you a sneak peek at the new couple features as well.

See ya soon!
